incident_date.quote: On Saturday 21st Feb night I was returning home

incident_time.quote: I left the venue around 11.15-11.30 pm.

incident_location.quote: On the ORR service road near Marathahalli there is a sharpish left

claimed_amount.quote: Their estimate is Rs 38,700 which is attached.

damage_description.value: The bike's tank got dented on the right side, the front fork is bent and the headlamp broke.
damage_description.quote: The bike's tank got dented on the right side, the front fork is bent and the headlamp broke.

facts.incident_summary: The policyholder was riding home from a wedding reception late at night and the bike slipped on loose mud near a sharp turn, crashing into a metal barrier. The vehicle sustained damage to the tank, front fork, and headlamp.

risk_mentions.quote: I had two-three drinks at the reception over the evening but I was feeling fine to ride.
